sentences.zh: 其实吹得非常好。

sentences.en: But listen to all of the instruments that Rain can play in real life, Angela.
sentences.zh: 但安吉拉，听听雷恩在现实生活中会玩的乐器吧。

sentences.en: He can play the recorder, piano, clarinet, saxophone, bassoon, guitar, drums, xylophone, bells, and a little tuba and baritone.
sentences.zh: 他会吹竖笛、钢琴、单簧管、萨克斯、巴松管、吉他、架子鼓、木琴、铃铛，还会一点大号和上低音号。

sentences.en: What are you, a one-man band, Rain?
sentences.zh: 你是什么，一人乐队吗，雷恩？

sentences.en: He kind of is.
sentences.zh: 他某种程度上确实是。

sentences.en: I knew you could play the bassoon because your book, The Bassoon King, is great.
sentences.zh: 我知道你会吹巴松管，因为你的书《巴松管之王》很棒。

sentences.en: So I knew that.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道这一点。

sentences.en: But I didn't know you were a walking one-man show.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道你还是个行走的单人秀。

sentences.en: Suffice it to say, Rain knew his stuff.
sentences.zh: 总之，雷恩确实很有料。

sentences.en: And we did rehearse, but just a little bit right before the scene.
sentences.zh: 我们确实排练过，但就在拍戏前稍微练了一下。

sentences.en: Rain and I practiced separately.
sentences.zh: 雷恩和我分开练习的。

sentences.en: I had listened to the song over and over again to memorize the words.
sentences.zh: 我把那首歌听了一遍又一遍，为了记住歌词。

sentences.en: I had to sing the first verse through the chorus.
sentences.zh: 我必须从第一段唱到副歌。

sentences.en: That's what I had to do over and over again.
sentences.zh: 那就是我一遍又一遍必须做的事情。

sentences.en: I was so nervous.
sentences.zh: 我当时紧张极了。

sentences.en: Well, I thought you did fantastic.
sentences.zh: 噢，我觉得你表现得棒极了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I have a fan question from the scene, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我这儿有个粉丝关于那个场景的问题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So Chelsea wrote in and said, was Angela's A-man improvised?
sentences.zh: 切尔西来信问，安吉拉那句“阿门”是即兴发挥的吗？

sentences.en: A lot of people wrote in about this because it was so quick after Pam was done talking.
sentences.zh: 很多人都写信问过这个问题，因为那句台词在帕姆说完话后接得太快了。

sentences.en: People wanted to know if I improvised that.
sentences.zh: 大家都想知道那是不是我即兴说的。

sentences.en: No, that was scripted.
sentences.zh: 不，那是剧本里写好的。

sentences.en: And folks wanted to know why did Angela do it.
sentences.zh: 大家还想知道安吉拉为什么要那么做。

sentences.en: And I said, I think personally, the direction that, you know, they gave me was that Angela had had enough of this charade, this bird funeral.
sentences.zh: 我个人觉得，导演给我的指导是，安吉拉已经受够了这场闹剧，这场鸟的葬礼。

sentences.en: Pam had gone on and on.
sentences.zh: 帕姆没完没了地说个不停。

sentences.en: Enough.
sentences.zh: 够了。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: I'm done.
sentences.zh: 我受够了。

sentences.en: And that...
sentences.zh: 而那……

sentences.en: That's how you finish it.
sentences.zh: 那就是你结束这一切的方式。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: I'm finished.
sentences.zh: 我说完了。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: Stop talking.
sentences.zh: 别再说了。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这样。

sentences.en: Speaking of the script, I have a script catch.
sentences.zh: 说到剧本，我发现了一个剧本上的出入。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, you know, in the scene, we set the box on fire.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在那个场景里，我们把盒子点着了。

sentences.en: In the shooting draft of the script, we buried the bird.
sentences.zh: 但在拍摄用的剧本草稿里，我们是把鸟埋了。

sentences.en: There was a scene where Michael and Dwight are digging a hole outside, and then we all gather around this hole.
sentences.zh: 原本有一场戏是迈克尔和德怀特在外面挖坑，然后我们所有人都聚在坑边。

sentences.en: And it got changed to fire, but I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 后来改成了火葬，但我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: I think maybe, Angela, there was really no grass in this area that we shot.
sentences.zh: 我想可能是因为，安吉拉，我们拍摄的那块地方根本没有草坪。

sentences.en: We had no grass.
sentences.zh: 我们那儿没草。

sentences.en: There was a hedge with maybe, like, I don't know, three feet of dirt.
sentences.zh: 只有一道树篱，后面大概只有三英尺宽的泥地。

sentences.en: Like, yeah, there was, I mean...
sentences.zh: 是啊，我是说……

sentences.en: Not even.
sentences.zh: 甚至还不到。

sentences.en: There is a deleted scene where Michael and Dwight are trying to dig a hole there, and then the business on the other side yells at them, and they run away.
sentences.zh: 有一个删减片段是迈克尔和德怀特试图在那儿挖坑，然后对面的人冲他们大喊大叫，他们就跑了。

sentences.en: Oh!
sentences.zh: 噢！

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, there you go.
sentences.zh: 原来如此。

sentences.en: Well, we had another fan question about this fire, then.
sentences.zh: 那我们还有另一个关于这场火的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Clara Johnson wants to know, did you actually set the bird on fire?
sentences.zh: 克拉拉·约翰逊想知道，你们真的把那只鸟点着了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Real fire, fake bird.
sentences.zh: 真火，假鸟。

sentences.en: Kent told me they had to hire a special effects guy to oversee the fire and the extinguishing, and they had to get a special permit.
sentences.zh: 肯特告诉我，他们必须雇一个特效人员来监督点火和灭火过程，而且还得申请特别许可证。

sentences.en: To be allowed to set the fire.
sentences.zh: 才能获准点火。

sentences.en: And he said we did three takes.
sentences.zh: 他说我们拍了三次。

sentences.en: Three takes of the fire.
sentences.zh: 火烧了三次。

sentences.en: And Phil told me, though, that the special effects guys were worried that the fake dead bird might give off toxic fumes when it burned.
sentences.zh: 不过菲尔告诉我，特效人员担心那只假死鸟燃烧时会产生有毒烟雾。

sentences.en: So we, they actually took it out of the box and just put a wad of toilet paper in there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们实际上把它从盒子里拿了出来，只在里面放了一团卫生纸。

sentences.en: Oh, not toilet paper.
sentences.zh: 噢，不是卫生纸吧。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Too soon.
sentences.zh: 太早了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Too soon, Angela.
sentences.zh: 太早了，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Too soon.
sentences.zh: 太早了。

sentences.en: And then, finally, we had a fan catch from Peter K.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们收到了彼得·K发来的粉丝留言。

sentences.en: He said, I noticed the box was burned in some shredded paper.
sentences.zh: 他说，我注意到盒子里烧了一些碎纸。

sentences.en: Could this be further evidence that Pam does use the shredder?
sentences.zh: 这是否能进一步证明帕姆确实用了碎纸机？

sentences.en: Oh, look at that.
sentences.zh: 噢，快看那个。

sentences.en: Nice one, Peter.
sentences.zh: 干得好，彼得。

sentences.en: It would appear so.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Jen actually left us a really great message about this scene.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，简实际上给我们留了一条关于这一幕的非常棒的留言。

sentences.en: And she was talking about the fact that we never got to shoot outside.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了我们从未在户外拍摄过这一点。

sentences.en: And when we did, everyone would get really excited.
sentences.zh: 而当我们真的去户外时，每个人都会感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And she explains a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 她对此做了一些解释。

sentences.en: So, Sam, can you play that?
sentences.zh: 所以，萨姆，你能播放一下吗？

sentences.en: One thing that I remember from the grief counseling episode is that when I went to the sound mix, they were showing us the playback of the episode.
sentences.zh: 关于《悲伤辅导》那一集，我记得的一件事是，当我参加混音时，他们正在给我们播放这一集的录像。

sentences.en: And it was still a little bit unusual when the characters went outside.
sentences.zh: 当角色们走到户外时，感觉还是有点不寻常。

sentences.en: It was still a little bit of a treat.
sentences.zh: 那仍然算是一种难得的体验。

sentences.en: So we get to this bird funeral scene and our characters are outside.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拍到了这场鸟儿葬礼的戏，我们的角色都在户外。

sentences.en: And I just remember hearing kind of an enormous amount of birds.
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时听到了巨大的鸟叫声。

sentences.en: And I think that it was because we were outside.
sentences.zh: 我想那是因为我们在户外。

sentences.en: It was because we had a bird funeral.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们在举行鸟儿葬礼。

sentences.en: It was so exciting for the amazing sound people, who do a fantastic job, to put a lot of bird noises in.
sentences.zh: 对于那些出色的音效师来说，能加入大量的鸟叫声一定非常令人兴奋，他们做得太棒了。

sentences.en: Because for the longest time, when we're inside the office, they're just putting dot matrix printer sounds and just faxes and old-fashioned office noises.
sentences.zh: 因为在很长一段时间里，当我们待在办公室里时，他们只能加入针式打印机的声音，还有传真机和老式办公室的噪音。

sentences.en: So it must have been such a treat and a field day to be able to go outside and hear birds, and especially on theme with the funeral.
sentences.zh: 所以能去户外听到鸟叫声，尤其是还契合葬礼的主题，对他们来说一定是一种享受，也是一次大显身手的机会。

sentences.en: So I remember, it was a slight exaggeration, but it sounded a little bit like Alfred Hitchcock, the birds, when I first heard the playback for the bird funeral.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得，虽然有点夸张，但当我第一次听到鸟儿葬礼的录音回放时，那些鸟叫声听起来有点像阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克的电影。

sentences.en: But they quickly made a wonderful adjustment, and it was the right amount of outside birds.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快做出了极好的调整，户外鸟叫声的量恰到好处。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一点。

sentences.en: I love that our sound mixers got so excited.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们的混音师们如此兴奋的样子。

sentences.en: They put like hundreds of birds, and they were like, okay, guys, there's not this many birds outside.
sentences.zh: 他们加了成百上千只鸟，然后他们意识到，好吧，伙计们，外面没这么多鸟。

sentences.en: Let's dial it back.
sentences.zh: 我们调小一点吧。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, what good insight from Jen this week.
sentences.zh: 噢，简这周的见解真好。

sentences.en: Yes, thank you so much, Jen Salata, for sending in those clips and for texting me.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常感谢简·萨拉塔发来这些片段并给我发短信。

sentences.en: You are amazing.
sentences.zh: 你太棒了。

sentences.en: We so appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: And thank you, Rashida, for letting me bug you about all kinds of random things yesterday.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你，拉什达，昨天让我为了各种琐事烦扰你。

sentences.en: And also, Phil Shea and Kent Sabornak, thank you guys for helping us make this podcast so great.
sentences.zh: 还有，菲尔·谢伊和肯特·萨博纳克，谢谢你们帮助我们让这个播客变得如此出色。

sentences.en: And thanks so much to Mindy Kaling for letting us take a clip from your book,
sentences.zh: 也非常感谢敏迪·卡灵允许我们引用你书中的片段，

sentences.en: Is Everyone Hanging Out Without Me and Other Concerns.
sentences.zh: 《大家都背着我出去玩吗？及其他忧虑》。

sentences.en: It's hilarious.
sentences.zh: 那本书太搞笑了。

sentences.en: We love you, Mindy.
sentences.zh: 我们爱你，敏迪。

sentences.en: So there you have it, guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，伙计们，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's the grief counseling episode.
sentences.zh: 这就是《悲伤辅导》那一集。

sentences.en: Did we do it?
sentences.zh: 我们做到了吗？

sentences.en: Are we leaving you depressed?
sentences.zh: 我们没让你们感到沮丧吧？

sentences.en: I hope not.
sentences.zh: 希望没有。

sentences.en: I hope not.
sentences.zh: 希望没有。

sentences.en: And hopefully next week, we won't have any more dead birds to tell you about in our lives.
sentences.zh: 希望下周我们的生活中不会再有死鸟要告诉你们了。

sentences.en: Stay safe out there, flying friends.
sentences.zh: 在外出时注意安全，飞翔的朋友们。

sentences.en: Stay safe out there, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家在外注意安全。

sentences.en: We love you.
sentences.zh: 我们爱你们。
